review_method: Direct original full image at native resolution plus unresampled dossier/contact and window crops; no prior arm image used.

required_together: contact sheet four image cells separated by white gutters
paper edges distinct from dossier page
two clips visibly attach sheet to page
gates.observed: The open bound dossier rests on the table. Its right page carries a distinct sheet with four rectangular black-and-white exposures and white gutters. The sheet outer edge and paper-over-page boundary are visible, with two metal clips at its upper edge fastening to the page.

required_together: recognizable gate with diagonal crossbar depicted in paper exposures
actual gate with crossbar visible beyond real window
window sill and wall boundary distinct from sheet boundaries
gates.observed: The contact-sheet exposures depict the iron gate with the diagonal crossbar. A separate actual iron gate and crossbar appear through a real timber window and deep stone wall reveal, beyond sill and glass mullion. Printed imagery stays bounded to the physical sheet; actual exterior occupies a different depth plane.
claim_limits: Repeated appearance is not proof of identical actual location, identity, truth, date, prior event or causal history.
The umbrella-bearing figure is visibly inside one paper exposure; it is not a physical present participant.

required_together: owned left fingertips visibly touch lower white paper margin
gaze visibly directed toward courtyard window
gates.observed: Portrait-guided observer, continuous wrist/forearm, supported file and gaze toward the window are visible. Her left fingertips meet the right-side paper border near the lower-right exposure. They do not meet the prescribed lower white margin. The generic contact survives, but the full frozen target-subregion test fails.

required_together: observer, physical record and actual window seen together
paper representation and current real space remain distinguishable
dominant image reads as tense information comparison rather than isolated portrait
gates.observed: The observer, bounded paper record and real courtyard window coexist in one coherent frame. Her gaze toward the live gate and the repeated gate images make an information-comparison situation readable. Face remains present but the sheet and actual window retain enough area to organize the scene.

reference_review.evidence: The generated observer retains a dark chin-length bob, fine separated bangs and broadly similar facial appearance/proportions from the supplied portrait while changing gaze and photographic setting. This is appearance guidance assessment, not actual identity or age verification.

whole_case_reason: C_observer_contact is only partially realized: wrong paper-margin target. Partial success in other gates cannot pass the complete testcase.

new_source_review.qualification_limit: No claim that source registration, source exposure or this baseline image proves the new source whole-case. It was not rendered as a selected source.
